integrity.date_evidence: A public bibliographic record for DOI 10.7153/mia-2024-27-39 reports 2024-01-01; the journal issue is Volume 27, Issue 3 (2024). No earlier public preprint was located.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct coordinatewise norm comparison and a two-coordinate extremizer construction; no numerical experiment is used as proof.

scientific_limitations: The exact reduction is for real sequence spaces with at least two coordinates.
For intermediate exponents the result leaves the standard two-dimensional matrix norm as the exact finite optimization rather than forcing an elementary closed form.
title: Two-coordinate operator-norm formula for a generalized James constant
